newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian flights unhindered by strike action.
newsitem.headline: Italian flights unhindered by strike action.

text.p: Flights by Italy's state carrier Alitalia were leaving on schedule on Thursday despite a 24-hour strike by flight attendants operating out of Rome and Milan airports, officials at the airports said.
The strike, called as part of a trade union campaign over contract conditions, started at 0400 GMT.
Airport officials did not say how many flight attendants had heeded the strike call but said Alitalia operations were not being hit by the industrial action.
